narratives.Description: security(install): pin+verify Linux --yes uv/task/gh bootstrap (install-deposit-02). This story remediates a confirmed AppSec finding from tracker #2904 with fail-closed tests and CHANGELOG citation. Parent umbrella remains open until all batch children merge.
narratives.Overview:
## Parent
Part of AppSec scan tracker **#2904** (2026-07-29). Remediation **Batch A** (installer authenticity).

## Finding
| | |
| --- | --- |
| **ID** | `install-deposit-02` |
| **Severity** | **High** |
| **Dimension** | `install-deposit` |
| **File** | [`cmd/deft-install/setup.go`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/master/cmd/deft-install/setup.go) |

## Issue
Linux non-interactive `EnsureCoreTools` bootstraps uv, task, and gh by downloading **unpinned** install scripts / latest tarballs into `~/.local/bin` with no checksum or signed-release verification.

## Impact
Compromise of astral.sh, taskfile.dev, or latest gh release (or MitM) yields arbitrary code under the user account on Linux `--yes` installs.

## Remediation
1. Mirror CI ghx pattern: download-to-temp + pinned SHA-256 (+ version-pinned assets) before execute/install.
2. Fail closed on mismatch.
3. Consider distro packages or pre-staged verified binaries for `--yes`.

## Acceptance
- [ ] uv/task/gh bootstrap paths under `cmd/deft-install` require pinned digests (or explicit documented residual)
- [ ] Fail closed on verify failure
- [ ] CHANGELOG / docs/security.md as needed

## Refs
- Tracker #2904
- Batch A sibling: install-deposit-01
- Contrast: CI `GHX_INSTALL_SH_SHA256` / #1070 class
narratives.UserStory: As a security engineer, I want pin and SHA-256 verify Linux --yes uv/task/gh bootstrap assets before exec, so that non-interactive EnsureCoreTools cannot run unpinned remote install scripts.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Open the source module files under cmd/deft-install/setup.go (and related paths: cmd/deft-install/setup.go, cmd/deft-install/, docs/security.md, CHANGELOG.md) and implement the fail-closed fix described in issue #2909. 2. Add or extend unit tests/fixtures that assert the security property; run verify commands: cd cmd/deft-install && go test ./...; task check:merge. 3. Update CHANGELOG.md and docs/security.md when the finding changes documented trust boundaries; collect evidence from test output before opening the PR.
